summary: Titan Mining Corp filed a Form 6-K with exhibits for its annual general meeting (AGM) to be held on June 25, 2026. The filing includes a notice-and-access notice, notice of meeting, management information circular, form of proxy, and annual return card. Resolutions include setting the number of directors at seven, electing directors, and appointing Ernst & Young as auditors. This is a routine AGM notice with no special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, activist campaign, or management change. No transaction terms are disclosed.
